scope: Permit one execution only of this exact script through the authoritative nanhai_plus_env.py --run wrapper to stage the three fixed read-only inputs on gz02. No graph, target build, container, Bridge or device release.

checks.authoritative_env: load_environment(local_env.md) current config SHA256 5ce3a58541ef1711890aad8348c3a31a03203f584fa50f1f5c0cb4fd88b49718 matches frozen constant; script compares all six REQUIRED bindings and wrapper SHA and demands host gz02.
checks.fixed_inputs: Current generate_manifest_heads.py SHA256 dafbc416c2b036ea8816591f408b24a8a99974827302968041474d54ef550634 and MANIFEST-HEADS.tsv SHA256 fe22e645511647b6b34dd83f5c0573ef1f8d45eaf380ac08b12c5120d1e13356 match script pins; third env JSON is deterministically derived from pinned config and raw local_env bytes and its SHA is recorded.
checks.remote_path_and_mode: Remote packet fixes exact three names/order. Project/control must be existing real directories; control is opened with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, leaf files with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW relative to dir_fd. New files are fsynced then fchmod(fd,0444) before close; remote rereads SHA and mode via fd. GZ02 Python 3.12.3 supports os.fchmod; prior unsupported chmod call removed.
checks.one_shot_and_receipt: Nonblocking exclusive flock and under-lock second receipt check occur before SSH. Status changes to REMOTE_STATE_UNKNOWN before subprocess.run, so post-attempt failures are not falsely marked pre-staging; catch path records error and atomic exclusive hard-link receipt. Existing receipt stops before SSH.
checks.remote_command: Only ssh gz02 python3 -c of the fixed staging program is invoked; source contains no graph, namespace/container or device launcher. Current remote control has none of the three destination files and local STAGING.json is absent.

post_execution_gate: Review actual STAGING.json, remote rc, returned three names/hash/mode, and remote files independently before any graph runner review; this GO does not imply source graph readiness.
limits: Static review and read-only host capability/path checks only; the staging script itself was not run here.
An uncatchable kill or external filesystem mutation can leave state requiring read-only reconciliation; never infer remote absence solely from a missing receipt.
